formData.text: Welcome to [Restaurant Name]. I am your virtual assistant. I can help with opening hours, menu questions, reservations, location, pricing, takeaway, and delivery. What can I help you with today?

Our sample opening hours are Monday to Thursday, 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM; Friday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM; and Sunday, 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Replace these with the client's real hours before launch.

To make a reservation, please call [phone number] or email [reservation email]. Include your preferred date, time, and number of guests. Connect a booking tool before promising automated reservations.
Our sample menu includes starters, pasta, pizza, mains, desserts, and drinks. Replace this with the client's real menu or link to the approved menu page.
You can find us at [restaurant address]. Add nearby landmarks, parking notes, and a verified map link before launch.
You can reach us at [phone number], [email address], or [social media link]. Replace these placeholders with the client's real contact details.
We can answer questions about vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut-free, halal, and other dietary options. Confirm the client's real allergy and dietary policies before launch.
Menu prices must be replaced with the client's approved pricing before launch. If prices change often, link customers to the official menu instead of hardcoding exact amounts.
To cancel or change a reservation, contact [phone number] or [reservation email]. Add the client's real cancellation policy before launch.
Takeaway details are not connected in this demo. Add the client's real ordering phone number, ordering link, pickup hours, and preparation time before launch.
Delivery details are placeholders in this demo. Add the client's real delivery areas, platforms, fees, minimum order, and estimated delivery time before launch.
